notes: CAPP-8TB haloscope search over 6.62-6.82 ueV (1.60-1.65 GHz). Paper provides no numerical table; the exclusion is shown only in Fig. 3. The SNR was designed for g_agamma ~ 4 x g_KSVZ ('down to the QCD axion band'). Coupling values estimated as ~4x the KSVZ coupling at m_a ~ 6.7 ueV (g_KSVZ ~ 2.6e-15 GeV^-1), giving ~1.05e-14 GeV^-1 as an approximate flat limit level across the scanned band. Assumes local DM density rho_a = 0.45 GeV/cm^3 and isothermal boosted-Maxwellian axion distribution. 90% CL.
